schema:funding.schema:name: Strategy Priority Research Program (Category B) of Chinese Academy of Sciences (XDB0710000); NSFC 42073022

ada:oxideProduction: ThO/Th = measured at <0.3%; U/Th = 0.95–1.05 (on NIST SRM 612)
ada:detectionLimit: LODs for 32 elements in Li-borate glass BHVO-2: 0.005–23.5 µg g⁻¹ (dilution-limited; much higher than undiluted glass LODs); LODs for NIST 610: 0.007–0.45 µg g⁻¹; LOQ = 3.3 × LOD (Pettke 2012) for most elements; LOQ for pollution elements = blank + 10SD (Gold Book IUPAC)
ada:limitOfQuantificationMethod: LOQ = 3.3 × LOD per Pettke (2012) for most elements; LOQ = blank value + 10SD per IUPAC Gold Book for pollution elements (V, Co, Zn, Ba, La, Ce, Ta, U) where blank contribution is significant
ada:withinSessionAnalyticalPrecisionAndA: Analytical precision (RSD) within 10% for most of 32 trace elements in 6 silicate GRMs (verified by homogeneity index assessment across 9 spots per disk)
ada:analyticalAccuracyAndAssessmentMetho: Analytical results within 10% of reference values for most of 32 trace elements in 6 GRMs (mafic to felsic); precision (RSD) within 10% for most elements; lunar basalt (NWA14526) and shergottite (NWA13190) results compared with SN-ICP-MS and found reliable

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sample Form / Analytical Substrate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Li-borate flux fusion glass disc (10 mg sample + 350 mg Li₂B₄O₇, 35:1 dilution)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Fusion Flux and Dilution Ratio
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Li₂B₄O₇ flux; sample:flux = 1:35 (10 mg sample + 350 mg flux)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sample Preparation Method
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Li-borate fusion: 350 mg Li₂B₄O₇ + 10 mg powdered sample fused in Pt-Au crucible (M4 automatic fluxer); glass surface cleaned with ethanol before LA

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Surface cleaning with ethanol before analysis

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Laser Spot Geometry
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: 100×100 µm square (stated as 100 µm diameter spot at 1 Hz)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Carrier Gas and Flow Rate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: He: 0.7 l min⁻¹ (chamber) + 0.1 l min⁻¹ (cup gas)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Plasma gas flow: 15 l min⁻¹; Auxiliary gas: 0.85 l min⁻¹

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: ICP Tuning
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Gas flows optimized via spot ablation of NIST SRM 612 to obtain maximum signal intensities while maintaining ThO/Th <0.3% and U/Th at 0.95–1.05

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Analysis Sequence
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Gas blank (25 s) → ablation (45 s) → washout (25 s); NIST 612 and 614 as external standards; BHVO-2 and 6 GRMs measured as unknowns

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Dwell Time per Mass
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: 30 ms (most isotopes) / 10 ms (alternate; dual detector mode)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Homogeneity index (H) applied to test element distribution; Co, Ni, Cu in high-Si glass (GSR-1) identified as near-LOD and flagged; flux blank contributions to pollution elements subtracted

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Applied: dual detector mode (30 ms / 10 ms dwell alternation)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Memory Effect Mitigation
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: 25 s washout between analyses (25 s gas blank → 45 s ablation → 25 s washout)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: No post-acquisition normalization beyond IS approach (two IS elements applied element-specifically)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Primary Calibration Standard Name
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: NIST SRM 612 + NIST SRM 614 (non-matrix-matched external standards); self-made BHVO-2 lithium borate glass (matrix-matched) tested as alternative but NIST 612+614 found sufficient with fs laser

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Secondary Reference Materials
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: AC-E (granite, CRPG), GSR-1 (granite, NRCG), JB-1b (basalt, GSJ), GSR-3 (basalt, NRCG), AGV-2 (andesite, USGS), W-2A (diabase, USGS) — 6 GRMs covering mafic to felsic rock types analyzed as unknowns; also NWA14526 (lunar basalt) and NWA13190 (shergottite) compared with SN-ICP-MS
